description: This file contains the PHP class 'Authorize' which extends the base Controller class, located in the Opencart\Admin\Controller\Mail namespace. It implements email-related functionalities for authorization and reset processes, including sending emails with specific views and configurations.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling email-based authorization and reset functionalities within the admin mail namespace.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the process of sending authorization or reset emails based on the route and inputs, including preparing email data, configurations, and invoking the mail sending process.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Prepares and sends a reset email, creating a URL with email and code parameters, with configurations similar to the index method.
